name: Vergence OverlapSphere
summary: An invisible sphere is placed at the 3D point where the two eyes' gaze rays converge, and the object nearest its centre is selected.
howItWorks: The sphere's radius covers the fovea plus the measured angular error; it ignores depth error, serving as a baseline. It was the least accurate of the four techniques because vergence depth is unreliable. The study (Varjo Aero) had users select atoms in a cluttered molecule model, confirming with a wink, which beat dwell and double blink in an earlier test.
limitations: Least accurate; fails when vergence depth is off.

relationships.note: Introduced with the other vergence-based techniques in the same thesis.
